title: 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate Election Results
text:
According to historical election results published by the North Carolina State Board of Elections (NCSBE), voters across all 100 North Carolina counties cast ballots in the November 3, 2026 U.S. Senate election.
Hover over any county on the interactive map below to inspect vote totals, candidate vote shares, and the percentage-point margin.






Data source: North Carolina State Board of Elections — Historical Election Results Data (November 3, 2026 precinct results file).
